title.zh: 简单电路 · 电流要走一圈
title.en: Simple Circuits · Current Must Go Round

desc.zh: 电池、开关和灯泡连成一个完整的圈，灯才会亮；断开一处，整圈的电流同时停下。
desc.en: A battery, a switch and a bulb joined into one complete loop make the bulb light; break it anywhere and the current stops all round at once.
